answer: Require each agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable work credential: for example, solve a randomly assigned task whose result is checked against hidden test cases, with rewards released only after a delay and a small stake forfeited for invalid work. One person can still create many identities, but each must spend real compute and time to earn credentials, while Sybils gain no advantage from merely multiplying accounts. A timber audit, nectar reward, or zephyr task label changes nothing about that cost.
